owner: tmm_monk stand-alone Monk engine and gameplay
source_original: RWTema Monk Mod 1.4 (1.12.2), open reference https://github.com/rwtema/Monk-Mod ; original code/art must NOT be copied
source_inventory: Original registered ability IDs crosschecked against compat/monk/profiles/original-monk-abilities-1.4.json on Monk prototype branch #71

claims.substitute_for_original_fly: verified post-Ender-Dragon native Momentum Gliding; external Draconic Evolution Curio flight is OPTIONAL and cannot be prerequisite for native completion
claims.no_duplicate_wallet: Monk cultivation / technique points are native, while global Tyz MXP wallet remains separate and not needed for any classic capability

progression_contract.initiation: First Sunset: sky-exposed western sunset meditation (existing prototype 200 tick window); standalone character state, not Vampirism faction join
earned_mastery_sources: completed legitimate barehand block breaks including TreeChop actual log count
first successful consumption of distinct food item IDs
progression_contract.full_rank_model: Core developer determines extended scalable rank cap/progression; source classic stage references are NOT mandatory hard gates. Only native cultivation must make every classic capability attainable without spending Tyz XP/SP.
progression_contract.core_ability_access: All 25 source abilities must be available (or expressly replaced) to a single maxed Monk without mutually exclusive purchases. Early 48-node experimental talent tree may supplement but may NOT be the only route to classic features.
progression_contract.health_toughness_full_breath_glass: All four registered-but-not-default-awarded abilities must be reachable via optional native milestones or free native trials. No Tyz purchase prerequisite.
progression_contract.one_time_unlocks: Earned native cultivation or trial flags independent of user-selected specialization. If using native technique points, reserve baseline grants for classic parity; optional enhancements may cost points.
progression_contract.mode_persistence: Native mode toggles (Fortune/Silk and Armor Lock), skill ownership, deeds, food discovery and cooldowns persist per player and sync server authoritative.

native_free_utility_contracts.contract: Permanent monk first hotbar slot remains genuinely empty and never accepts a stack; all GUI/number swap/pickup, creative, grave restore and modded insertion hooks use no-loss policy. Other 8 hotbar slots normal. Not purchasable.

native_free_utility_contracts.input: default-ON user toggle, no SP cost
native_free_utility_contracts.contract: No new equipment may enter vanilla four armor slots while ON. ON/OFF always allowed. Worn removable items move only with legal space; non-removable damageable items wear at default 1 normal durability-damage attempt per 20 server ticks per slot until break, with ordinary Unbreaking/repair; Life Mending may drain health lethally; OFF stops wear, never bypasses actual worn-armor Monk penalties. Curios unaffected.

native_free_utility_contracts.input: one native Fortune versus Silk Touch mode switch
native_free_utility_contracts.contract: One server-persisted mutually exclusive Fortune I/Silk Touch I hand-harvest technique. Eligible after native unlock and correct harvest tier, no Tyz required; later Tyz Fortune bonus may enhance without becoming prerequisite. Retain Glass Touch as a distinct source behavior.

standalone_integration.transformation_policy: Monk is a chosen discipline, not species. Preserve established incompatible transformation rules, but owning spellbooks/spellcasting alone does not disqualify; integration must not reference Vampirism symbols. Hunter coexistence remains an explicit unresolved design choice.
standalone_integration.tyz_boundary: No classic capability or its native baseline requires Tyz installed, MXP earned, Tyz levels purchased or Tyz tab rendered. Tyz may give optional improvement overlays after baseline works, never supply a missing core ability.
standalone_integration.optional_ars_irons: Existing Ars Nouveau/Iron's supply ranged combat; NO native Spirit Projectile. Individual classic ability (Catch Arrows, Withering Stare) operates independently of external spell mods.
implementation_policies: Use new original Java implementation; do not copy 1.12 source or assets.
Server-authoritative state and effects; client GUI is display/input only.
No permanent stale transient attributes or duplicated modifiers on logout/death/faction exit.
Claims, entity protections, game rules and boss immunity respected.
All source break/drop mechanics verified with the actual 1.21.1 server loot context.
Every core ability must have an explicit integration test, including source-disabled runs without Tyz.
deliberate_deviations: No innate creative flight; post-Dragon controlled Momentum Gliding replaces it.
Blindness is a temporary ordeal rather than mandatory permanent debuff; alternate accessible completion allowed.
True source 'potion immunity' must cover ordinary vanilla negative effects; exemptions for protected boss/system debuffs must be explicit and tested.
Numerical source magnitudes are original parity/balance references; pack-scale values can be adjusted after a demonstrated native substitute exists.

abilities.name: Unarmored Natural Defense
abilities.source_effect: Cumulative armor attributes: +1, +2, +4, +8, +14, +18, +20 at original milestones.
abilities.native_target: Monk-native unarmored defense available before Tyz.
abilities.implementation_contract: Server reconciles conditional, unique-ID armor modifiers; exact classic +20 terminal target is a balance anchor. No conventional armor or disallowed equipment, no lingering buff after leaving Monk.
abilities.acceptance_tests: Progresses while unarmored; equipping conventional armor suspends instantly, removing restores; relog/death/respec cannot duplicate modifiers.
abilities.progression: earned_native_cultivation; no Tyz purchase, MXP, native SP expenditure, or optional external mod required

abilities.name: Unarmored Toughness
abilities.source_effect: Original configurable numeric armor toughness attribute, available but not in default 20-level route.
abilities.native_target: Native armor toughness advancement independent of Tyz; accessible to every advancing Monk.
abilities.implementation_contract: Separate native attribute modifier and costless milestone/trial grant; no equipment item, no duplicate shared Tyz effect. Final magnitude requires balance testing because classic default had no numeric value.
abilities.acceptance_tests: Earned and retained through progression without any Tyz purchase; unarmored only; damage simulation with high-damage hits.
abilities.progression: earned_native_cultivation; no Tyz purchase, MXP, native SP expenditure, or optional external mod required
additional_constraints: Registered but never default-awarded; numeric tuning is a new decision, not fabricated classic value.

abilities.name: Blindness Ordeal
abilities.source_effect: Original imposes recurring Blindness at milestone 17 and removes it upon blind combat completion at 18.
abilities.native_target: Optional temporary cultivation ordeal, not a permanent positive talent or forced global debuff.
abilities.implementation_contract: Enter and exit a server-owned ordeal state through native practice; temporary blindness applies only during challenge; completion cures ordeal; alternate accessibility path should allow equivalent progression without requiring visually impaired gameplay.
abilities.acceptance_tests: During trial blindness is applied only to correct player; on completion/logout/death/abort clears; does not become purchasable power or indefinitely trap player.
abilities.progression: optional_monastic_trial; no Tyz, never a paid talent

abilities.name: Blink
abilities.source_effect: Original aimed line-of-sight ~16-block teleport, ~40 tick local cooldown.
abilities.native_target: Native keybound short-range teleport; no Ars or Iron's requirement.
abilities.implementation_contract: Target chosen and validated SERVER-SIDE against max range, chunk loading, collision, blocks, protection, dimension, cooldown; never trust client-supplied arrival coordinate. Preserve short-hop identity, not free unrestricted teleport.
abilities.acceptance_tests: 16-block capped attempt with 40-tick default cooldown (balance tunable); wall, lava, unloaded target, claims and player collision denied; no dupes or no-clip.
abilities.progression: earned_native_cultivation; no Tyz purchase, MXP, native SP expenditure, or optional external mod required

abilities.name: Catch Arrows
abilities.source_effect: Original intercepts eligible incoming arrows while unarmed, may put collectible arrow in inventory.
abilities.native_target: Native projectile interception when discipline permits; not a spell or projectile granted to Monk.
abilities.implementation_contract: Before-impact or cancelable verified hit handler for actual arrows; require facing/reaction cone and empty/valid hands. Cancel actual damage once, no free infinite item duplication; eligible pick-up only.
abilities.acceptance_tests: Frontal incoming arrow blocked/caught; back/side or unqualified equipment not blocked; creative/infinity/pickup-disallowed arrows do not mint items; modded projectile list explicit.
abilities.progression: earned_native_cultivation; no Tyz purchase, MXP, native SP expenditure, or optional external mod required

abilities.name: Creeper Kiss
abilities.source_effect: Original empty-hand right-click pacifies and persistently marks creeper as harmless via AI removal.
abilities.native_target: Native affectionate creeper interaction; compatible with current mob AI, not additional pets or summon mechanics.
abilities.implementation_contract: Server-authoritative empty-hand entity interaction; marks creeper persistently, interrupts swelling/targeting; respects other mods' boss/special creepers; avoids permanent global AI override.
abilities.acceptance_tests: Creeper becomes harmless after interaction and persists across reload; no duplicate pets, no touch through walls, non-Monk cannot apply effect.
abilities.progression: earned_native_cultivation; no Tyz purchase, MXP, native SP expenditure, or optional external mod required

abilities.name: Blast Resilience
abilities.source_effect: Original multiplies eligible explosion damage by 0.5 (50% reduction), not total immunity.
abilities.native_target: Native explosion resistance tuned against original 50% anchor.
abilities.implementation_contract: Damage-source-tag event adapter with a single application per explosion; doesn't accidentally mitigate unrelated magic, bypass boss damage, or stack twice with native armor and Tyz.
abilities.acceptance_tests: TNT and vanilla creeper damage reduction near original 50% reference; other damage types unaffected; zero damage bypass exceptions respected.
abilities.progression: earned_native_cultivation; no Tyz purchase, MXP, native SP expenditure, or optional external mod required

abilities.name: Feather Fall
abilities.source_effect: Original fall damage multiplier 0.2 (~80% reduction) plus separate jump ability reduces effective fall distance.
abilities.native_target: Native robust fall protection, not an external potion/curio requirement.
abilities.implementation_contract: Use verified fall-damage handling; preserve original ~80% mitigation benchmark independent of Tyz, distinguish from Jump's small safe-fall bonus; don't nullify intentional void damage.
abilities.acceptance_tests: Falls 40+ blocks: substantial reduced but nonzero damage; no double stacking from repeated events; elytra/gliding and slime behavior tested.
abilities.progression: earned_native_cultivation; no Tyz purchase, MXP, native SP expenditure, or optional external mod required

abilities.name: Ascension / Momentum Glide
abilities.source_effect: Original grants true Creative-style flight through allowFlying; original capstone uses void-fall ordeal.
abilities.native_target: Explicit approved exception: replace innate creative flight with post-Ender-Dragon Momentum Gliding, allowing controlled non-creative fall-flying; optional external Draconic Evolution Curio can provide actual flight but is NOT needed for Monk completion.
abilities.implementation_contract: Native mobility with safe glide initiation, maneuvering, limited thrust/energy or cooldown and fall handling; never sets creative flight flags, never requires Vampirism, Tyz, or actual DE item to count as completed Monk.
abilities.acceptance_tests: After credited Ender Dragon defeat glide works without any Tyz skills or Curios; no flight before gate; no creative flight/hover; external Curio flight unaffected.
abilities.progression: verified_server_side_Ender_Dragon_milestone; innate glide automatic, no Tyz
additional_constraints: Only explicit classic capability not replicated literally; creative flight deliberately prohibited.

abilities.name: Glass Touch
abilities.source_effect: Original barehanded glass-only silk-like drop; not the same as a universal Silk Touch enchantment.
abilities.native_target: Native glass harvesting distinct from Treasure Hand Fortune/Silk switch.
abilities.implementation_contract: For valid player bare-hand glass breaks, calculate drops once through correct loot context; preserve panes, colored glass and modded glass as explicit whitelist; reject tile/block-entity duplication.
abilities.acceptance_tests: Bare hand drops ordinary glass block only when valid; container/glass block entities not duplicated; no extra ore Silk Touch granted.
abilities.progression: earned_native_cultivation; no Tyz purchase, MXP, native SP expenditure, or optional external mod required
additional_constraints: Registered classic ability omitted by default progression, still part of full target.

abilities.name: Purifying Meditation
abilities.source_effect: Original continuously removes ALL effects flagged 'bad' each server tick after Wither milestone.
abilities.native_target: Native high-end comprehensive harmful-potion cleansing/immunity, no Roots/Ars prerequisite.
abilities.implementation_contract: At final cultivation the Monk should rapidly suppress all normal vanilla harmful MobEffects as source parity. Explicitly classify modded curses, long-form bosses and non-potion hazards; do not silently apply only a tiny limited cleanse then call it equivalent. Server authoritative, opt-in exclusions to protect intended encounters configurable.
abilities.acceptance_tests: Vanilla Poison, Weakness, Slowness, Mining Fatigue, Wither and Blindness (unless chosen ordeal ongoing) automatically clear/suppress at high rank; beneficial effects persist; dangerous boss mechanics require declared exceptions.
abilities.progression: earned_native_cultivation; no Tyz purchase, MXP, native SP expenditure, or optional external mod required
additional_constraints: TMM may exclude protected boss/system-tagged effects, but such exclusions are documented deviations and must not erase the classic vanilla-potion suite.

abilities.name: Meditative Vitality
abilities.source_effect: Original registered max-health attribute multiplier; no default milestone/number.
abilities.native_target: Intrinsic native max-health advancement; independent of Tyz or Werewolf's health tree.
abilities.implementation_contract: Give positive, bounded native Max Health bonus through stable attribute modifier; magnitude requires balance approval. Preserve current/maximum health transitions safely.
abilities.acceptance_tests: Can unlock on standalone Monk with Tyz absent; survives relog; toggling discipline doesn't heal infinitely; no duplication from repeated updates.
abilities.progression: earned_native_cultivation; no Tyz purchase, MXP, native SP expenditure, or optional external mod required
additional_constraints: Optional classic registration with no source default numeric anchor; magnitude provisional.

abilities.name: Hunger Discipline
abilities.source_effect: Original rolls back roughly 50% of ordinary food-level drops after they occur.
abilities.native_target: Intrinsic slower natural exhaustion/hunger loss, without replacing food-discovery mastery.
abilities.implementation_contract: Modify verified food/exhaustion delta only once and cap by normal survival rules; maintain reason to eat different foods; hunger immunity is not promised.
abilities.acceptance_tests: At matched sprint/action inputs hunger/exhaustion consumption approaches half of vanilla reference; food still consumable and rewards first-ever food discovery one time.
abilities.progression: earned_native_cultivation; no Tyz purchase, MXP, native SP expenditure, or optional external mod required

abilities.name: Monk Leap
abilities.source_effect: Original multiplies jump upward velocity by 1.2 and reduces effective fall distance by 3.
abilities.native_target: Native jump impulse increase and bounded safe-fall improvement.
abilities.implementation_contract: Separate server-authoritative jump impulse and safe-fall benefit from Step Assist. Do not replace by a step-height attribute alone.
abilities.acceptance_tests: Normal standing jump is visibly higher; safe fall +3 equivalent; sneak, swimming, speed/step and Feather Fall interactions have no runaway stacking.
abilities.progression: earned_native_cultivation; no Tyz purchase, MXP, native SP expenditure, or optional external mod required

abilities.name: Empty-Hand Mining & Harvest Tier
abilities.source_effect: Original combines harvest tier 0,1,2,3,5 and speed increase 0,+2,+5,+9,+12 (original multiplication 1+speed). Harvest tool whitelist varies with tier.
abilities.native_target: Standalone native finite harvest-tier AND native speed ladder; both work before Tyz or external mining tools.
abilities.implementation_contract: Compute actual effective hand-tool rules, vanilla/pack tags and loot tables. Staged tier equivalents stone/iron/diamond/netherite only where meaningful; early generic wood/dirt; optional exotic only if real tags. Native speed bonuses native-owned and available at increasing cultivation milestones; Tyz may add extras later without being prerequisite.
abilities.acceptance_tests: Log, dirt, stone, iron ore, diamond ore, obsidian and modded tool-tag blocks drop correctly only at qualified hand tier; tested successful break credit; no block break bypass on claims, no XP farm from repeated placed blocks.
abilities.progression: earned_native_cultivation; no Tyz purchase, MXP, native SP expenditure, or optional external mod required
additional_constraints: Classic harvest_level 5 is a legacy ordinal, not directly a modern 1.21.1 tag tier. Translate by actual block/tool behavior.
Tyz speed ranks may later supplement, but must not be required to reach classic high-speed native baseline.

abilities.name: Fire Resilience
abilities.source_effect: Original multiplies ordinary fire damage by 0.5.
abilities.native_target: Native fire damage reduction ~50% anchor.
abilities.implementation_contract: Damage source tags, burn duration/combustion behavior independently checked; no blanket all-magic shield.
abilities.acceptance_tests: Fire contact and fire ticks reduce damage while disciplined; lava handled separately; no duplication with lava protection.
abilities.progression: earned_native_cultivation; no Tyz purchase, MXP, native SP expenditure, or optional external mod required

abilities.name: Lava Survival
abilities.source_effect: Original contextual lava handling: if submerged and not already burning, extinguishes/briefly grants Fire Resistance and prevents the triggering fire damage; otherwise no extra multiplier.
abilities.native_target: Standalone contextual lava protection, distinct from ordinary fire resilience; do not promise universal lava immunity if source didn't.
abilities.implementation_contract: Server verifies current fluid collision and incoming damage; bounded protection or recovery when entered from clean state, with persistent lava exposure hazards and normal balancing.
abilities.acceptance_tests: Test stepping into flowing/source lava, already-burning character, normal fire damage and overlap; no infinite damage immunity or persistent potion granted after leaving lava.
abilities.progression: earned_native_cultivation; no Tyz purchase, MXP, native SP expenditure, or optional external mod required

abilities.name: Swift Step
abilities.source_effect: Original +0.4 then +0.8 movement speed modifier, doubled while sprinting; custom FOV adjustment.
abilities.native_target: Native staged walking and sprint speed bonuses with at least meaningful classic sprint specialization, independent of Tyz.
abilities.implementation_contract: Conditional movement attribute modifiers; apply once with stable IDs, synchronize speed on sprint transitions and suppress while conventional armor worn. Calibrate against original benchmarks and other sprint mods to prevent overflow.
abilities.acceptance_tests: Walk and sprint speed differ; no stuck sprint multiplier, no infinite stacking; movement remains meaningful when Tyz not installed.
abilities.progression: earned_native_cultivation; no Tyz purchase, MXP, native SP expenditure, or optional external mod required
additional_constraints: Exact original +0.8 amount and twice-while-sprinting scaling is a source benchmark, not automatically approved endgame pack balance.

abilities.name: Step Assist
abilities.source_effect: Original increases step height while unarmored; crouching can suppress step-up.
abilities.native_target: One native Step Assist; no duplicate Apotheosis Elastic purchase.
abilities.implementation_contract: Server stable attribute/collision reconciler, 1-block normal step and possible 1.25-1.5 classic later tier; respect crouch toggle; no sticky modifier.
abilities.acceptance_tests: Step up 1 block only when learned and eligible; crouch restores normal movement; removal/relog clears; no stack with duplicated Elastic.
abilities.progression: earned_native_cultivation; no Tyz purchase, MXP, native SP expenditure, or optional external mod required

abilities.name: Iron Palm / Unarmed Strength
abilities.source_effect: Original bonus to unarmed attack damage +1,+2,+4,+8,+16 at key stages.
abilities.native_target: Native staged empty-hand damage up to classic endgame performance before Tyz.
abilities.implementation_contract: Real unarmed damage attribute modifier keyed to empty-hand/qualified magic focus rules; don't interpret spellbook as a weapon; only legal fist melee attacks get it, no doubling magical spells.
abilities.acceptance_tests: Unarmed damage grows across cultivation; holding conventional sword disables; hand slot key 1 works; Tyz removed leaves baseline intact.
abilities.progression: earned_native_cultivation; no Tyz purchase, MXP, native SP expenditure, or optional external mod required

abilities.name: Animal Friendship

abilities.native_target: Native animal empathy/soothing and limited breeding interaction; no new summon/pet submod.
abilities.implementation_contract: Server-side right-click appropriate vanilla/modded animals; preserve taming, breeding cooldowns and grief protections; no hostile mob mind control, no auto-spawn pets.
abilities.acceptance_tests: Angry eligible animal calms; eligible adult animal enters love following normal rules; invalid species/child/claims no effect.
abilities.progression: earned_native_cultivation; no Tyz purchase, MXP, native SP expenditure, or optional external mod required

abilities.name: Water Walking
abilities.source_effect: Original adds temporary collision support atop source water; shift/sneak or submersion permits diving, not walking across all liquids.
abilities.native_target: Intrinsic water-surface walking with deliberate dive/sneak escape, no gear/potion.
abilities.implementation_contract: Scoped collision/physics or buoyancy hook only for eligible Monk; don't create blocks, grant lava walking, or interfere with boats and swimming.
abilities.acceptance_tests: Walk over source water, sneak to dive, swim when submerged; client/server stay synchronized; non-Monk has vanilla fluid physics.
abilities.progression: earned_native_cultivation; no Tyz purchase, MXP, native SP expenditure, or optional external mod required

abilities.name: Breath Meditation I
abilities.source_effect: Original partial air regeneration (adds 2 air in selected underwater updates); not permanent full water breathing.
abilities.native_target: Native reduced drowning pressure / partial air recovery, with visible distinction from full breath.
abilities.implementation_contract: Server updates air at controlled cadence; avoid oxygen duplication or client flicker; doesn't give full indefinite breathing.
abilities.acceptance_tests: Time until drowning extended versus baseline but eventually depletes; underwater exploration works with no Tyz.
abilities.progression: earned_native_cultivation; no Tyz purchase, MXP, native SP expenditure, or optional external mod required

abilities.name: Breath Meditation II
abilities.source_effect: Original sets air to full 300 each server tick; no full-breath reward in default config.
abilities.native_target: Native full underwater breathing unlockable to all Monks at a later native progression milestone.
abilities.implementation_contract: Maintain air without fake potions; works in underwater combat/special dimensions when actual breathing mechanics apply; optional ability should not require Tyz.
abilities.acceptance_tests: Indefinite ordinary underwater breathing after native unlock; partial phase remains distinct before upgrade; no oxygen duplication or forced water walking.
abilities.progression: earned_native_cultivation; no Tyz purchase, MXP, native SP expenditure, or optional external mod required
additional_constraints: Registered classic power never default-awarded; native optional milestone needed for full suite.

abilities.name: Withering Stare
abilities.source_effect: Original gazing at undead within ~20 blocks inflicts Wither for 200 ticks; exposed (unarmored phase) vanilla Wither boss also takes 5 direct damage from stare.
abilities.native_target: Native sustained line-of-sight harmful gaze against eligible undead, with source-specific boss interaction.
abilities.implementation_contract: Server ray/angle/LOS, actual undead-tag checks, cooldown/interval and boss armor-phase rules; no free arbitrary-target spell, no fake projectile.
abilities.acceptance_tests: Gaze works on qualifying undead in range and LOS, fails behind wall/against ineligible mobs; Wither damage/phase behavior source-faithful, protected mobs unaffected.
abilities.progression: earned_native_cultivation; no Tyz purchase, MXP, native SP expenditure, or optional external mod required

acceptance_gates: Without Vampirism, Werewolves or Tyz installed, Monk loads and First Sunset initiates one Monk with persistent unique state.

With only standalone Monk installed, one character can reach and use the entire default classic suite across advancement, including all physical/nature/defense mechanics, without spending a single Tyz point.

All 25 original registered ability IDs appear exactly once; 4 source-default-unused abilities remain obtainable natively; only original creative flight is an explicitly documented non-equivalent replacement.
Ender Dragon-verified Momentum Gliding works on a Monk without Draconic flight Curio; external Curio can later add creative flight independently.
No classic physical or defensive numeric baseline is accidentally hidden behind a Tyz or extra paid talent prerequisite; advanced optional Tyz boosts may stack only via a documented single owner.
First hotbar Fist and Armor Lock are independent free protections with no loss/duplication; confirm Life Mending and Binding interaction in a disposable world.
Movement, melee, mining, defensive and potion interactions use server authoritative handlers; client packet and canceled event attempts do not grant rewards.
Rank + food set + all native abilities persist through death/rejoin/clone/dimension transfer; one-time achievements/points never double-award.
Classic original milestones may become optional challenges or rewards; First Sunset and a small number of explicit checkpoints only are mandatory, not all 20 old deeds.
All 25 abilities and each utility feature have standalone integration acceptance before any Tyz adapter is activated.
